attempts.diagnosis: Fake camera interface, technical overlays, bars, and reference-presentation framing contaminated the result.
The clip exposed the raw portrait and generated a large inverted lower panel with a hard seam.
Scene-first composition passed, but the generated woman was not Zantara.
Scene-first composition and canonical wardrobe passed; identity improved but remained below the exact 0.600 unlock threshold.

causal_conclusion: Camera-prompt originality is no longer the limiting variable. The common failure is the handoff from a landscape identity anchor to a clean portrait scene-start that both preserves A007 and avoids raw-reference presentation artifacts.

next_gate.scope: Benchmark a small set of materially different identity-preserving start-frame methods with exact ArcFace, raster, and composition gates. A new camera family or fifth f01 variant is not authorized by this decision.
